title: A small game, three directions
summary: An editable reference board for **Mr. Mak 64**. Compare the character and locations, keep notes, and save the next idea beside its image. The prompts below are suggested next iterations.

items.title: The gentleman
items.body: Keep the character small and the hat easy to recognise. Review the silhouette at gameplay size before adding more detail.
items.alt: Mr. Mak character concept wearing a top hat
items.prompt: Next iteration: keep the small proportions and top hat. Simplify details that disappear at gameplay size.

items.title: Somewhere to begin
items.body: A calm first area with room to practise. Give the player a clear destination and enough space to try the first jump.
items.prompt: Next iteration: show one clear route from the starting area to a recognisable landmark. Keep foreground obstacles easy to read.

items.title: A little further up
items.body: A second area for testing jumps between islands. Use the gaps to establish rhythm before increasing the difficulty.
items.prompt: Next iteration: arrange three floating islands around a readable jump path. Give each landing a distinct silhouette.
